kind: independent frozen catalog inventory optimization review

semantic_review.conclusion: inventory performs a new complete listing each call; keys projects that fresh inventory to sorted exact strings. Manager stores no cross-call listing/authority cache. Explicit authority entries originate only from the current _catalog_locked listing; standalone _generation_authority freshly enumerates.

Listed sizes are never used as admission totals. authority_bytes and every historical root/index—including orphan index—are freshly statted via stable locator. Root/index membership and final combined count/byte checks remain. The latest-root key remains a string for publication comparisons.

Connected stat(locator) revalidates metadata schema/key and stable object ID through fresh metadata. Native host metadata independently checks the selected live folder, nontrashed binary type and immutable name. Descriptor locators still drive referenced segment reads; same keys cannot bypass original object identity checks.

_read_remote_json still performs fresh bounded stat, reserved download and original hash measurement. Connected get performs another fresh stat and independent stable-ID original download with bypass_cache. Root key names remain bound to original root hash/sequence; each segment still matches exact descriptor hash/size. Publication index/root put paths retain independent original-byte readbacks.

Full prefix checking, validated metadata, duplicate keys/object IDs across pages, token validity/repetition/page bound, object limit and combined response bytes remain enforced. Native incomplete/truncated/saturated listing rejection remains in unchanged host adapter; no new support for saturated native folders is claimed.

Transports without callable inventory retain existing keys behavior. _publish still performs a separate fresh roots keys listing immediately before upload, rejects changed latest root and retains both capacity checks/readback steps. Coordinator/mutation ownership checks are unchanged.

Recorded isolated adapter counts show 4 listings,14 metadata calls,4 original downloads and unchanged1616 bytes/6 objects versus original5 listings,10 lookups,4 metadata calls,4 downloads. Native32-versus44 tool figures are explicitly source-derived, not live provider measurements. This reviewer checked the stated formulas against unchanged native list/metadata/download source; no live latency/throughput inference is made.
